A QUICK REFERENCE

A

Make a fist with your thumb resting along the side of your index finger. Keep your palm facing forward.

This prototype recognizes isolated fingerspelling handshapes, not conversational ASL, grammar, or facial expressions. J and Z require motion and are excluded from automatic recognition. Results vary with lighting, camera angle, and signer.
